source.title: Clostridioides difficile-induced diarrhoea following dasatinib therapy

figures.caption: Sigmoid colon showing confluent ulceration with mucosal erythema.
Superficial mucosal ulceration with fibrin and neutrophils; numerous neutrophils in lamina propria, suggestive of non-specific colitis.
Colonoscopy image demonstrating resolution of colonic ulceration following 2 weeks of antibiotic therapy.
